findings.text: non-blocking: the store subdirectory 'agent' is a second literal copy of the path fragment the omp-local flight declaration carries as 'agent/models.yml' (operator flight.yaml harness_home_files for omp-local), and no test compares the pair — a change to the declaration alone would point omp at an empty store while every test stays green; derive the subpath from the declaration or assert the two agree.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit: 8616dfcf49 adds _HARNESS_AGENT_STORE and harness_agent_store in reckon/_worker_fence.py, applies it in reckon/_backends.py:2884 and adds two tests; 5507340a7e and 3d615da8dd add and extend only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when asks for a test seeding an omp run home from an operator ~/.omp/agent/models.yml asserting HOME and PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, a seeded file at <run home>/agent/models.yml, unchanged claude/codex environments, the failing launch reproduced, and no added ruff findings; tests/test_omp_dialect.py:272-335 supplies all of it, and I re-ran that file at head to 26 passed in 26.51s.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to make a fenced omp run read the models.yml the fence seeds by setting PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<run home>/agent beside HOME; reckon/_backends.py:2884 applies it through harness_agent_store and a live probe of the pinned harness prints 'ready' with the variable and 'not found' without it.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it states status complete, commits 8616dfcf49/5507340a7e/3d615da8dd, 77 passed at the head arm against 73 passed with 2 scaffolding errors at base, a negative control red with KeyError and EXIT=1, and a probe pair; the cited logs support each claim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared scope is reckon/_backends.py, reckon/_worker_fence.py, tests/test_omp_dialect.py and the node's own evidence fragment; git diff 1d53433deb..3d615da8dd changes exactly those four paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_omp_dialect.py:304 fails with KeyError: 'PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR' when reckon/_backends.py:2884 is replaced by a no-op, as logs/negative-control.log records, but the 'agent' subpath at reckon/_worker_fence.py:57 is not compared against the flight declaration it must match.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-arm.log ends '73 passed, 2 errors in 20.58s' with EXIT=1 and a git ls-tree exit 128 traceback, logs/after-arm.log ends '77 passed in 38.43s' with EXIT=0, and logs/negative-control.log ends '1 failed, 25 passed' with EXIT=1; my own ruff run returns the same two pre-existing findings at reckon/_backends.py:723 and :3751, neither on a changed line.
justifications.fit: reckon/_worker_fence.py:56-63 places the new table beside _HARNESS_HOME and documents the mechanism, and reckon/_backends.py:2879-2884 applies it through the same environment dict as the home variable.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:2884 sets PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=<run home>/agent beside HOME for omp only, and the resolve-probe logs show the harness resolving local/deepseek-v4.1-flash with it and refusing it without.
justifications.reuse: harness_agent_store at reckon/_worker_fence.py:206 extends the module that already owns the per-dialect harness-home environment mapping (harness_home at :192), returning entries for the same dict rather than forking a second launch-side convention.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 1d53433deb 3d615da8dd lists only reckon/_backends.py, reckon/_worker_fence.py, tests/test_omp_dialect.py and docs/evidence/fragments/workers-spend-fewer-tokens-per-landed-node/omp-models-path.html.
